```{r}
# Import packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Import data
ghg <- read.csv(here("data", "ers_plan_global", "DATA", "ers_plan_global_v5_5_0.csv"))

glimpse(ghg)

library(httr)

url <- "https://api.climatetrace.org/v7/sources/:id"

response <- VERB("GET", url, content_type("application/octet-stream"), accept("application/json"))

content(response, "text")
ghg_ranking_sources <- fromJSON(rawToChar(response$content))
glimpse(ghg_ranking_sources)
```
